body.x: Invoxia(www.invoxia.com), a designer, innovater, and manufacturer of telecommunication devices aimed at improving comfort and simplifying the user experience, unveiled "Triby" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Triby, the voice of the connected home, enables better communication between family members at home. Communication is done by just a push of a button, so there is no need of a separate mobile phone or landline with this device. It functions like a classic walkie-talkie, but has more modern and advanced features like sending emoticons and drawings, receiving text from a mobile, and playing music or Internet radio.
